name: Probabilistic, gradient and slice blends
plain: Blends that pick values rather than mix them. Prob modes jitter t with noise or pick per element. Gradient makes a triangular ratio ramp across the flattened tensor or one dim. Slice modes rank or cut along a dim. Stochastic modes draw from torch's global RNG, so they depend on seed state rather than a widget.
math:
stochastic: t′=t+U(−fuzz,fuzz) per element, optional clamp; lerp(a,b,t′)
gradient: peak=int(n(1−t)); ratios rise to peak then fall, ×0.9
slice_blend, probselect: read by name and signature only
